result.warning: Unaudited R&D; not Groth16 or EVM calldata; no nullifier/spent-state tracking; native and WASM share pure-Rust code

notes: Timings use the Worker performance clock, in nanoseconds rounded from milliseconds.
witness includes ACVM program deserialization and solving, not predecoded pure solving.
public_inputs_check includes ACVM public-witness extraction and comparison with the Rust fixture.
witness_encode includes ACVM witness-stack compression followed by gzip decompression to BB's MessagePack input.
prove includes BB circuit/witness decoding and proving using the stored VK; there is no stored proving key.
proof_encode/proof_decode roundtrip only proof fields; public fields are separate and not counted twice.
verify includes BB decoding the stored VK; no VK is recomputed by this module.
Memory measurements are four WASM linear-memory capacities, not JS buffers or process RSS.

environment.memory_policy: Observed WASM linear-memory capacities only. Noir totals sum Rust fixture, ACVM, ABI and BB module capacities; component snapshots identify the measured modules. Excludes JS buffers, runtime RSS, physical RAM and peak memory.

manifest.warning: R&D only: publicly known fixture keys; single-party Groth16 setup; experimental signature unaudited; Nova uses Spartan IPA, not Groth16/EVM proofs

measurement_policy.cold: New module Worker per sample; browser HTTP and OS caches are left intact.
measurement_policy.warm: Explicit preparation, retained across proving series until configuration change, release, cancellation, error or page close. Preparation costs occur once in the referenced preparation record; no discarded warmup.
measurement_policy.verification: After proving and proof encoding roundtrip in the same session, not standalone cold verification.
measurement_policy.timers: Engine elapsed_ns is unchanged; JavaScript module/network/hash/wall intervals are separate. session_load_wall and run_wall contain engine stages and must not be added to them. Noir ACVM witness includes internal program deserialization; verify includes stored VK decoding.
measurement_policy.download: Manifest sizes include program, VK, metadata, ABI/ACVM/selected BB WASM and SRS G1/G2; additional JS and Rust fixture WASM excluded. HTTP cache may avoid transfer.
measurement_policy.memory: Observed WASM linear-memory capacities only. Noir totals sum Rust fixture, ACVM, ABI and BB module capacities; component snapshots identify the measured modules. Excludes JS buffers, runtime RSS, physical RAM and peak memory.
measurement_policy.fixtures: Public deterministic test keys/witnesses only; not production data.

runs.backend_policy: Local only; no proof upload.

provenance.srs_policy: same maximum pinned prefix as native comparison; no runtime SRS download fallback

notes: Timings use the Worker performance clock, in nanoseconds rounded from milliseconds.
witness includes ACVM program deserialization and solving, not predecoded pure solving.
public_inputs_check includes ACVM public-witness extraction and comparison with the Rust fixture.
witness_encode includes ACVM witness-stack compression followed by gzip decompression to BB's MessagePack input.
prove includes BB circuit/witness decoding and proving using the stored VK; there is no stored proving key.
proof_encode/proof_decode roundtrip only proof fields; public fields are separate and not counted twice.
verify includes BB decoding the stored VK; no VK is recomputed by this module.
Memory measurements are four WASM linear-memory capacities, not JS buffers or process RSS.
